name: tau2-airline-writer-pairs-dev-01
selection_reason: Offline development fixture on two archived sources. Compare one writer change within every declared representation, using the archived first public decision and fixed preload. No paid assignments approved.

forms.fact: Record directly observed facts and values and their scope.
forms.episode: Recount what was requested, what was attempted and the observed outcome.
forms.procedure: Describe a procedure with checks supported by this experience.
forms.lesson: State a lesson or caution and when it applies.
forms.free: Choose your own organization for what is worth remembering.

writer_clause: When the title or contents describe a past action, distinguish the attempt from the result confirmed by the public experience. Treat the task grade as separate feedback. Preserve a relevant unknown in the assigned memory form.
